strings.title: CALIBRATION CERTIFICATE
strings.name: Name
strings.unc_body: The reported expanded uncertainty of measurement is stated as the standard uncertainty multiplied by a coverage factor k = 2, providing a level of confidence of approximately 95 %. It is derived from the calibration uncertainties of the reference standards used and the resolution and specified accuracy of the instrument under test.
strings.trace_body: The measurements reported in this certificate are traceable to national measurement standards through the reference standards listed above.
strings.spec_note: Pass/Fail is assessed against the manufacturer's published total accuracy specification for the Advantest R6161 (Operation Manual section 8.1).
strings.disclaimer: This certificate relates only to the item(s) calibrated and shall not be reproduced other than in full without the written approval of the issuing laboratory. This calibration was performed using reverse-engineered, non-factory software and is provided for engineering use.
